key.name: use-cli-config
key.summary: Use agent-quota provider configuration
key.description: Use the provider selection in agent-quota's config.toml instead of the extension list.

key.name: override-providers
key.summary: Override the agent-quota provider configuration
key.description: Use the extension provider selection instead of config.toml.

key.name: providers
key.summary: Providers shown by the extension

key.name: provider-order
key.summary: Custom display order of providers in the popup
key.description: An empty list preserves the order from config.toml or default provider list.

key.name: codex-workspaces
key.summary: Codex workspaces shown by the extension
key.description: An empty list shows every detected Codex workspace.

key.name: codex-workspace-options
key.summary: Detected Codex workspaces available in preferences

key.name: refresh-seconds
key.summary: Refresh interval in seconds

key.name: warning-threshold
key.summary: Remaining percentage that turns meters yellow

key.name: critical-threshold
key.summary: Remaining percentage that turns meters red

key.name: show-reset-when-full
key.summary: Show reset time for full meters

key.summary: Show Claude reset time when full

key.summary: Show Codex reset time when full

key.summary: Show Copilot reset time when full

key.name: show-settings-action
key.summary: Show Settings action in the popup

key.name: show-user-info
key.summary: Show user information in provider headers
key.description: Show the account name next to each provider plan in the popup. Turn off to show only the plan.

key.name: show-org-name
key.summary: Show organization names in Team/Business plans
key.description: Append the Claude or Codex workspace name to Team/Business plan labels. Turn off to show only the plan family.

key.name: meter-style
key.summary: Quota progress indicator style
key.description: Render percentage quotas as compact gauges ('circle') or full-width horizontal bars ('bar').

key.name: browser-claude
key.summary: Claude cookie browser

key.name: browser-codex
key.summary: Codex cookie browser

key.name: browser-copilot
key.summary: Copilot cookie browser

key.name: browser-zen
key.summary: OpenCode Zen cookie browser

key.name: provider-padding
key.summary: Vertical padding around provider groups in bar mode

key.name: header-spacing
key.summary: Spacing between provider header and quota bars

key.name: metric-spacing
key.summary: Spacing between quota metrics in bar mode

key.name: circle-provider-padding
key.summary: Vertical padding around provider groups in circular mode

key.name: circle-header-spacing
key.summary: Spacing between provider header and circular quota rows

key.name: circle-metric-spacing
key.summary: Spacing between circular quota rows

key.name: circle-radius
key.summary: Radius of circular quota gauges in pixels

key.name: circle-columns
key.summary: Number of circular quota gauges per row

key.name: provider-columns
key.summary: Maximum provider columns
key.description: Manual layout uses this as the column count when no explicit breaks are set. Auto grid chooses the squarest column count up to this value.

key.name: metric-options
key.summary: Detected quota bars per provider
key.description: Internal list of provider:label entries written by the popup so Preferences can offer per-provider bar visibility switches.

key.name: hidden-metrics
key.summary: Hidden quota bars
key.description: Provider:label entries hidden from the popup. An empty list shows every detected bar.

key.name: provider-layout
key.summary: Provider column layout
key.description: Manual respects the provider column count and explicit column breaks. Auto grid packs providers into the squarest grid up to the maximum column count, preserving provider order.

key.name: provider-column-spacing
key.summary: Horizontal spacing between provider columns in pixels

key.name: provider-column-breaks
key.summary: Providers that start at the top of a new column

key.name: circle-text-position
key.summary: Position of label and reset text relative to gauges
key.description: Place the window label and reset time centered below each gauge ('below') or to its right ('right').

key.name: gauge-percent
key.summary: Gauge percentage text
key.description: Show the value in the gauge opening as 99%, 99, or not at all.

key.name: gauge-percent-offset
key.summary: Gauge percentage distance from centre
key.description: Move the gauge percentage below the centre by this percentage of the gauge radius. 0 keeps it centred; 100 puts it at the bottom edge.

key.name: gauge-percent-font-size
key.summary: Gauge percentage font size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the value inside the gauge. 0 derives the size from the gauge radius.

key.name: gauge-label-font-size
key.summary: Gauge label font size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the window label below each gauge.

key.name: gauge-reset-font-size
key.summary: Gauge countdown font size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the reset countdown below each gauge.

key.name: popup-width
key.summary: Width of provider rows in the popup

key.name: popup-layout
key.summary: Widget popup layout
key.description: JSON layout for the widget-style popup. An empty or invalid value makes the popup build a default layout (one card per provider, packed into the global grid); the settings page writes this key once a layout is saved.

key.name: layout-columns
key.summary: Global widget grid columns
key.description: Number of gauge columns shared by every provider card in the widget layout.

key.name: layout-gap
key.summary: Widget card and cell gap
key.description: Horizontal and vertical gap between provider cards and gauge cells in the widget layout.

key.name: layout-padding
key.summary: Widget card inner padding
key.description: Space between a card background and its header and gauges.

key.name: layout-gauge-spacing
key.summary: Widget gauge spacing
key.description: Horizontal and vertical space between gauge cells inside a card.

key.name: show-reset-when-full-global
key.summary: Show reset time when a widget gauge is full
key.description: Apply one reset-display rule to every provider card in the widget layout.
